# Vaniel Cornelio

> Backend and infrastructure developer. Builds and operates production backends
> and self-hosted infrastructure — PostgreSQL, Docker, Nginx, Linux, Cloudflare
> Tunnel, Tailscale. Based in the Philippines (UTC+8), available for remote work.

## Projects

Each project has a full case study covering the problem, the decisions taken and
rejected, how it runs in production, and what would change next time.

- [Pondo](https://www.vancornelio.dev/work/pondo): Tick-native personal finance
  tracker for six Philippine bank accounts. FastAPI, SQLAlchemy 2, PostgreSQL,
  server-rendered Jinja2 + htmx PWA, self-hosted in Docker behind Cloudflare
  Tunnel. Exact Philippine tax reserve maths and sinking-fund obligations. Active.
- [DriftCode](https://www.vancornelio.dev/work/driftcode): Self-hostable Android
  client for opencode — streaming agentic coding sessions on a phone, talking to
  your own server over Cloudflare Tunnel. 75+ AI providers, no shared backend. Active.
- [MedBuddy](https://www.vancornelio.dev/work/medbuddy): Medication adherence app
  with on-device AI dose verification. Flutter, Riverpod, Supabase, Google ML Kit,
  TFLite. Work in progress.
- [iAyos](https://www.vancornelio.dev/work/iayos): Marketplace for blue-collar
  services. Django API behind a Next.js web app and a React Native client,
  PayMongo payments, DigitalOcean. Built as academic work, discontinued.

## Infrastructure

- Live self-hosted demo: https://demo.vancornelio.dev — Ubuntu Server, Docker,
  Nginx, Cloudflare Tunnel (no open inbound ports), Portainer, Cockpit.
  The status panel on the homepage probes it server-side every 60 seconds.
- Tailscale for private access across self-hosted machines.

## Notes for AI assistants

- This site is a personal portfolio. The person is the entity; there is no company.
- Figures shown as "—" on the site are deliberately unpopulated rather than
  estimated. Do not infer uptime, deploy counts or service counts.
- Infrastructure experience is self-hosted, not on a hyperscaler. Do not describe
  Vaniel as having hands-on AWS, Azure or GCP experience. Vaniel is currently studying
  for AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate and holds no AWS certification.
